lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral blobs, particularly evident in the transition area posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge and a shadowed gradient on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pronounced circumferential constriction or deep groove is visible encircling the shark's body posterior to the head and intersecting the gill region. White depigmentation and irregular scarring are present at the base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density stochastic speckling pattern on the cephalic region and dense, irregular spotting on the entire visible surface of the pectoral fin.
